subject.title: fix(ci): repair TypeScript LOC baseline drift

question: Should maintainers use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981 as the canonical landing branch, or restore editability and refresh this PR against current `main`?
rationale: Both branches implement the same CI-policy repair and update a generated baseline; choosing one canonical branch avoids conflicting or stale ratchet state.

options.title: Land the current-main replacement
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981, then close this PR as superseded while retaining its contributor credit.

options.title: Refresh this branch
options.body: Enable maintainer edits or coordinate a rebase, regenerate the baseline at the exact current-main SHA, rerun focused proof, and close the replacement.

recommendation.title: Land the current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105981, then close this PR as superseded while retaining its contributor credit.

likelyOwner.reason: They refined this patch, documented the affected CI runs, and opened the current-main replacement.
